guide.autoturgy.0:
AUTOTURGY • FIELD NOTES
A workshop of measured signals and careful observation. This foundation preview integrates with Thaumaturge 1.0.4 on NeoForge 1.21.1. Later storage, fluids, golems and constructs are still in development. Every registered device here performs its stated task. Search these notes by any word.
guide.autoturgy.1:
DIRECTION & CONTROL
Place a device with its marked face toward you. The marked front emits power; the rear receives it. Right-click empty-handed for controls. A clock can also be started by sneak-clicking it. A comparator reads progress or measured strength. Never point an output back into its own input.
guide.autoturgy.2:
ORDINARY HOURGLASS
Choose 5–60 seconds in five-second steps. Sneak-click, use Start, or apply a rising signal at the rear. The clock runs once and ends with a two-tick pulse. The comparator rises from 0 to 15 as time passes. Elapsed time is saved; unloading pauses time.
guide.autoturgy.3:
MAGIC HOURGLASS
Set precise whole seconds up to one hour. Outputs: completion pulse, power while running, a latch alternating at each completion, power while running with a repeat gap, or disabled. Repeat starts another period. Restart permits a new trigger to reset elapsed time. Cancel-on-falling clears the current period. Powered/unpowered trigger modes pause time when their condition is absent; Ignore waits for manual activation and ignores redstone.
guide.autoturgy.4:
REDCRYSTAL ROUTING
Crystals attach to the face you place them against. Adjacent crystals on that same surface share signals. Enabled corner routing wraps a shared support block. Each world-direction face can be Off, Input, Output, or Both. Normal propagation loses one strength per surface step. Internal power can exceed 15; emitted vanilla power is capped at 15. A graph above 512 crystals refuses power.
guide.autoturgy.5:
SPECIAL REDCRYSTALS
Amplified crystals raise any positive incoming power to 31. Dim crystals cap it at their adjustable limit; Dense crystals reject values below their adjustable threshold. Resonating pairs carry a signal straight up to 15 blocks, through solid blocks, without distance loss. Remove the source and even cyclic networks turn off. Mercurial mirror routing awaits the transport phase.
guide.autoturgy.6:
EYES & REMOTE READINGS
Sneak-use a crystalline eye on the target face; its tooltip records dimension, position and face. Use it on a reader to copy the link without consuming the eye. Targets must be loaded, in the same dimension and within 20 blocks. The remote comparator reads a target with a comparator output. Invalid targets produce zero; readers never load chunks.
guide.autoturgy.7:
VIS READER
Reads host jars through their selected-sided capability, crucibles, nodes, infusion demand wand-bearing arcane workbenches and recharge pedestals. Choose Total, Highest, Lowest or Aspect Count; invert if needed. Choose an aspect by name; that stable ID remains selected when contents change. Capacity 0 uses jar/crucible/node or actual wand capacity; unknown storage and infusion demand need manual capacity. Wand amounts use centivis. Aspect Count emits the number of types directly and ignores selection/capacity. Node highest/lowest compares current/base fullness, including depleted aspects. Reader access never consumes essentia.
guide.autoturgy.8:
RUNIC FILTERS
Open a filter and click a carried stack into a ghost square; your real stack stays on the cursor. Left-click with an empty cursor clears a sample. Right-click an existing sample with an empty cursor increases its quantity; Shift-click an inventory stack adds a sample. Blacklist toggles conversion without clearing data. Components, damage, shared item tags and matching mod can be selected independently. Sneak-use while another filter is in your off hand to copy all settings. Apply a filter to a tally by right-clicking it.
guide.autoturgy.9:
TALLY & ENTITY SENSING
The tally counts matching items accessible for extraction from the selected face. Minimum and Full-strength counts map the total to power. Chains have a 16-hop cycle guard. Unbound lenses count loose items near the target; Yield lenses predict normal and silk-touch alternatives with a suitable tool and isolated deterministic RNG, without breaking the block. Dynamic/random loot is sampled in those two contexts rather than exhaustively enumerated. An Entity Eye binds a creature type or a specific player; sneak-use it to bind yourself. Signum Entia counts all entities, including vehicles, in an 11-wide box shaped by its six adjacent faces. One blocked side extends the opposite reach to ten; two blocked ends suppress that axis. Glass and replaceable neighbors are ignored, and distant walls do not change the box. The modern half-span control can reduce the default five. Age selection applies to living entities only. Player identity can be required or ignored to detect all players. Raw counts up to 255 remain available to redcrystal.
guide.autoturgy.10:
RECIPES & CURRENT LIMITS
All foundation items have crafting-table recipes visible in recipe viewers. These are interim costly material recipes; host research and magical recipe costs will be integrated in the recipe phase. Other phases will add Inventarium totals and requisition demand to tally readings. No feature parity with the historical reference is claimed. This mod uses original code, textures and guide text.
